app.name: VidFriends
app.tagline: Videos from your friends, and nobody else.

common.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

errors.invite_invalid: This invite link is not valid. It may have expired, been used up or been revoked. Ask your friend for a new one.
errors.setup_invalid: That setup token is not correct. Copy it again from the server log.
errors.account_suspended: This account is suspended. Contact your server admin.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do that.
errors.csrf_failed: Your session needs refreshing. Reload the page and try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.network_error: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.
errors.cooldown: You can send another request to this person later.
errors.upload_incomplete: The upload did not finish. Please try again.
errors.url_not_allowed: That link isn't from a supported site, or it isn't a public web address.
errors.quota_exceeded: You've used all your storage. Ask your server admin for more.
errors.storage_full: This server is out of storage space.
errors.already_watched: Your friend already watched this, so it can't be unsent.

fieldErrors.username_format: Use 3–30 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dots or underscores, starting with a letter or digit.
fieldErrors.password_common: This password is too common. Pick something less guessable.
fieldErrors.password_equals_username: Your password must not be your username.
fieldErrors.not_an_image: That file is not an image we can use.
fieldErrors.not_a_video: That file isn't a video we can use.

setup.title: Set up your VidFriends server
setup.intro: Claim this server to become its admin. You'll find the one-time setup token in the server log.
setup.tokenHelp: Printed in the server log as “enter the setup token: …”.
setup.instanceNameHelp: Shown to everyone who joins, for example “The Smiths”.
setup.claimed: This server has already been set up.

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: to {{name}}
login.noAccount: No account? Ask a friend on this server for an invite link.
login.expired: Your session ended. Please log in again.

join.title: Join {{name}}
join.displayNameHelp: What friends see. You can change it later.
join.usernameHelp: 3–30 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dots and underscores. It can't be changed.
join.trust: Your server admin can technically access stored data. Only join servers run by people you trust.
join.appHint: Using the VidFriends app? Open it and scan the same QR code from inside the app.
join.haveAccount: Already have an account? Log in

home.title: Home
home.intro: This is your private feed of videos your friends send you. Invite friends to get started.

settings.title: Settings
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other sessions were logged out.
settings.logoutEverywhereHelp: Ends every session on every device, including this one.
settings.displayNameHelp: What your friends see. Up to 50 characters.
settings.avatarHelp: An image up to 2 MB. It's cropped to a square.

invites.title: Invites
invites.intro: Invite people you trust. Each invite is a link (and QR code) that lets someone create an account on this server.
invites.maxUses: How many people can use it
invites.autoFriendHelp: People who join with this invite become your friends right away.
invites.createdHelp: Share this link or let them scan the QR code. For security it is shown only now.
invites.qrLabel: QR code for the join link
invites.revokeConfirm: Revoke this invite? Nobody will be able to use it any more.
invites.notAllowed: Only admins can create invites on this server.

friends.title: Friends
friends.intro: Friends are people who can send you videos and receive yours. Friendship needs both of you to agree.
friends.noFriends: No friends yet. Search above or send someone an invite.
friends.blockConfirm: They won't be able to find you, send you videos or ask to be friends. Videos between you are deleted. You can unblock later, but the friendship won't come back automatically.
friends.removeConfirm: You will stop seeing each other as friends. You can ask again later.

send.title: Send a video
send.intro: Paste a link from TikTok, YouTube, Instagram and more, or upload a video file.

status.link_only: We couldn't download this one, so friends will get a link to the original.

reasons.too_large: It's larger than this server allows.
reasons.too_long: It's longer than this server allows.
reasons.unsupported: That site or link isn't supported.
reasons.unplayable: The file isn't a playable video.
reasons.fetch_failed: The site didn't let us download it.

send.notAVideo: That file isn't a video we can use.

feed.title: Your feed
feed.label: Videos from your friends
feed.empty: Nothing here yet. When friends send you videos, they show up here.
feed.caughtUpHelp: Keep scrolling for videos you watched recently.
feed.linkOnly: This video is only available on the original site.
feed.keyboardHelp: Use ↑ and ↓ (or j and k) to move, Space to play or pause, m to mute.

lists.savedEmpty: Nothing saved yet. Save videos from the feed to find them here.
lists.unsendConfirm: Unsend this video? Your friend won't see it any more.

share.title: Conversation
share.private: Only you and {{name}} can see this conversation.

sendStep2.title: Send to friends
sendStep2.noFriends: You don't have friends here yet. Add some on the Friends page.
sendStep2.pendingNote: It will reach them as soon as the video is ready.

push.title: Notifications on this device
push.help: Get a notification when friends send videos, react or reply. Messages show only the sender's name, never the content.
push.enabled: Notifications are on for this device.
push.unsupported: This browser doesn't support push notifications.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings.

types.share_watched: When friends watch what I sent
